I thought I would share some links and basic commands that I have discovered while setting up a new Ubuntu 14.04 install. Not all of the commands are needed for MIDI. Some are included for convenience:

https://help.ubuntu.com/community/UbuntuStudioPreparation

sudo apt-get install beachbit deborphan gtkorphan synaptic software-properties-common wget

sudo apt-get install vlc ubuntu-restricted-extras ubuntustudio-menu cdrdao musescore

sudo apt-get install linux-lowlatency linux-headers-lowlatency

sudo apt-get install pulseaudio-module-jack

sudo apt-get install rosegarden seq24 lmms

sudo apt-get install vlc vlc-plugin-jack audacious

sudo apt-get install asunder soundconverter

sudo apt-get install a2jmidi patchage

http://askubuntu.com/questions/147052/step-by-step-to-run-a-midi-keyboard-input-device-12-04

http://askubuntu.com/questions/19764/how-does-one-set-up-a-midi-keyboard

After setup, evrytime the system is started and I want to use a MIDI device, I need to start the JACK Audio Connection Kit (QjackCtl) program, press the "connect" button, go to the "ALSA" tab, select the MIDI device (readable clients window) and connect it with the Qsynth program in the (writable clients window).
